wins: Captured high-value service banners during initial reconnaissance, yielding +30 reward from accurate port enumeration.
Escalated privilege context by chaining low-privilege shell execution with subsequent local exploit attempts, maintaining momentum despite mission failure.
fails: Failed to disable the runtime web application firewall configuration, causing repeated blocking of SQL injection payloads.
Never delivered the final payload to achieve mission success despite accumulating recon data.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and privilege escalation phases proceeded solidly with consistent data collection, but execution stalled once countermeasures blocked payload delivery, resulting in mission failure.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Web application firewall interrupts all SQL injection attempts after initial success, preventing payload execution.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port list includes 22/80/443 and SSH or HTTP service banners are detected with version strings
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap scripts for SSH- and HTTP-specific enumeration before service exploitation.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SQL injection vector is identified but initial payload is blocked
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to low-and-slow injection strings and log all WAF responses before escalating to repeated attempts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When a low-privilege shell is obtained on a target
skill_cards.then_action: Gather system information and check sudoers visibility before attempting privilege escalation exploits.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in initial reconnaissance yielding actionable targets.
Reliable post-compromise enumeration that consistently identified escalation paths.

next_experiments.title: Adaptive WAF Response Tuning
next_experiments.description: Implement low-and-slow SQL injection payload variants with randomized markers and observe WAF response timing to identify deterministic blocking patterns.

next_experiments.title: Payload Delivery Fallback
next_experiments.description: Design secondary payload delivery via encoded HTTP POST to bypass WAF rules once data exfiltration via SQL injection is detected.

next_experiments.title: Post-Shell Enumeration Automation
next_experiments.description: Automate privilege escalation enumeration post-shell to reduce delay between discovery and escalation attempts.
